blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Users increasingly rely on AI systems for extended, multi-turn tasks, yet evidence indicates that LLM-based system performance degrades over prolonged interaction. To evaluate and improve AI assistants in such settings, we need user simulators that faithfully follow complex user intents while exhibiting realistic conversational behavior. Existing approaches manifest a trade-off: prompted assistants can follow complex user intents but lack behavioral fidelity, while specialized user simulators better approximate conversational behavior but struggle to remain faithful to complex intents. In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) recipe that jointly rewards task intent adherence and behavioral naturalness. A crucial contribution of the method is operationalizing naturalness with a lightweight discriminator trained in an alternating, adversarial loop with the user simulator. We release the resulting model, UserLM-2.0, which produces valid simulated conversations (i.e., meeting both task-faithfulness and naturalness criteria) 46.2% of the time, over three times the rate of the strongest prior user simulator (14.1%).
blocks.zh: 用户越来越多地依赖AI系统来完成扩展的,多回合的任务,然而有证据表明基于LLM的系统性能会因为长时间的相互作用而退化. 为了在这样的环境下评价和改进AI助手,我们需要忠实地遵循复杂的用户意图的用户模拟器,同时表现出现实的对话行为. 现有方法体现了一种权衡:被激励的助手可以遵循复杂的用户意图,但缺乏行为上的忠诚,而专业的用户模拟器则更接近对话行为,但努力保持对复杂意图的忠诚. 在本文中,我们提出了一个强化学习(RL)的配方,共同奖励任务意向守信和行为自然. 这种方法的一个重要贡献是,在与用户模拟器交替、对抗性循环中,对轻量级歧视者进行训练,使自然性发挥作用。 我们释放了产生的模型UserLM-2.0,该模型产生有效的模拟对话(即同时满足任务可靠性和自然性标准)46.2%的时间,是最强的前用户模拟器(14.1%)的三倍以上.

In comparison, assistants such as GPT-5.6-Sol follow intents, but sound unnatural, while SFT-trained simulators like UserLM-8B ( Naous et al., 2026 ) generate natural, but meandering conversations.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Users increasingly expect AI assistants and agents to help them accomplish complex tasks through sustained, multi-turn interaction, rather than provide isolated answers to individual queries ( Handa et al., 2025 ; Chatterji et al., 2025 ) . Yet prior work has shown that current LLM-based systems severely degrade in performance in such interactive settings ( Laban et al., 2025 ; Tack et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 用户越来越期望AI助手和代理通过持续的多回合互动来帮助他们完成复杂的任务,而不是为个别查询提供孤立的答案(Handa等,2025;Chatterji等,2025.). 然而,先前的研究表明,目前基于LLM的系统在这种互动环境中的性能严重退化(Laban等人,2025年;Tack等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Understanding and addressing this gap requires evaluations that capture how real users communicate their goals and respond to assistants over multiple turns ( Chang et al., 2025a ) . A crucial component of interactive benchmarks is a user simulator , which takes as input a high-level task intent (such as the one shown in Figure 1 ) and generates plausible user utterances through iterative interaction with an assistant ( Yao et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 要了解和解决这一差距,就必须进行评价,了解真正的用户如何通过多个回合来交流其目标并对助手作出回应(Chan等,2025a)。 互动基准的一个关键组成部分是用户模拟器,该模拟器将高级别任务意图(如图1所示)作为输入,通过与一名助理的迭接互动生成可信的用户言论(姚等,2024;吕等,2025;黄等,2025)。

blocks.en: We focus on two essential properties of user simulators: task fidelity and behavioral naturalness. Task fidelity requires the simulator to convey the information specified in the task intent over the course of the conversation, without omitting or contradicting the specification. Behavioral naturalness requires the simulator to resemble real users in both how it phrases individual messages and how it conducts the interaction across turns. A simulator that omits task requirements can make assistant models appear to fail when the simulator is at fault, making benchmarking unreliable ( Mehri et al., 2026c ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) , whereas a simulator that does not adequately capture the interactive behavior of real users may yield conclusions that do not transfer to real interactions ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Seshadri et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们专注于用户模拟器的两个基本属性:任务忠心和行为自然. 任务忠诚要求模拟器在谈话过程中传递任务意图所指定的信息,而不会省略或与规格相矛盾. 行为自然性要求模拟器既要像真实的用户一样,既要用它来表达个人信息,也要用它来进行跨转弯的交互. 省略任务要求的模拟器可以在模拟器出错时使辅助模型显得失败,使基准不可靠(Mehri等,2026c; Zhou等, 2026 ),而一个不能充分捕捉到真实用户交互行为的模拟器可能会得出不会转移到真实互动的结论(Zhou等, 2026; Seshadri等, 2026 ).

blocks.en: We show experimentally that current approaches favor one requirement at the expense of the other. Prompting LLM assistants to act as users is the most common method for simulating users ( Yao et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) . While prompted assistants can stay on task, they lack behavioral naturalness ( Naous et al., 2026 ; Mehri et al., 2026a ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . This is illustrated in the example in Figure 1 , where GPT-5.6-Sol (a strong assistant LLM) accurately enacts the task intent but expresses it through unusually polished and exhaustive messages, unlike the conversational patterns in real user-AI exchanges.
blocks.zh: 我们实验性地表明,目前的做法倾向于一种要求,而牺牲另一种要求。 促使LLM助理担任用户是模拟用户的最常用方法(姚等,2024;吕等,2025;黄等,2025.). 虽然受到激励的助手可以继续执行任务,但他们缺乏行为自然性(Naous等,2026;Mehri等,2026a;Zhou等,2026)。 图1的例子说明了这一点,其中GPT-5.6-Sol(一个强大的LLM助理)准确颁布了任务意图,但通过异常被打磨而详尽的信息表达,这与真正的用户-AI交换中的对话模式不同.

blocks.en: An alternative is to train user simulators by “flipping the dialogue”: supervised finetuning an LLM on user utterances from a corpus of user-assistant interactions ( Naous et al., 2026 ; Suh et al., 2026 ) . As reported in prior work, such finetuned user simulators exhibit realistic interaction behavior but often struggle to precisely enact the task intent they are given ( Naous et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . In the example in Figure 1 , the SFT-trained UserLM-8B ( Naous et al., 2026 ) ends the conversation prematurely, before conveying all of the specified task requirements to the assistant.
blocks.zh: 另一种办法是培训用户模拟器,方法是“解开对话”:监督地从用户-协助者互动中微调用户言论的LLM(Naous等,2026;Suh等,2026)。 如先前的作品所报道的,这些微调的用户模拟器显示出现实的交互行为,但往往会挣扎于精确地制定他们给出的任务意图(Naous等,2026;周等,2026). 在图1中的例子中,SFT训练有素的UserLM-8B(Naous等,2026年)在将所有指定的任务要求传达给助手之前,过早地结束了对话.

blocks.en: We propose a post-training recipe that improves task fidelity while preserving behavioral naturalness in user simulators. We first finetune an LLM on user turns from a corpus of user-assistant interactions, then post-train it using multi-turn reinforcement learning.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个训练后食谱,可以提高任务忠诚度,同时保留用户模拟器中的行为自然性. 我们首先微调一个LLM的用户转折,从一个用户-协助者互动的集合,然后使用多回合强化学习来进行后训练.

blocks.en: Our RL training objective jointly rewards task fidelity and behavioral naturalness. Rewards related to task fidelity use LLM-based judges ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , for example by evaluating the extent to which a simulated conversation has conveyed the information specified in the task intent. We find that LLM-as-a-judge for behavioral naturalness fails to reliably encourage realistic user behavior. Instead, drawing on adversarial training ( Goodfellow et al., 2014b ) and its application to dialogue generation ( Li et al., 2017 ) , we propose a discriminator-based reward for behavioral naturalness. Specifically, we continually retrain a discriminator to distinguish real user conversations from conversations generated by the user simulator being trained. This choice defines the naturalness reward in terms of how indistinguishable a given simulated conversation is from real user conversations. We update the discriminator as the simulator evolves to keep the naturalness reward responsive to its changing outputs and reduce opportunities to exploit a fixed evaluator ( Gao et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的RL训练目标 共同奖励任务忠诚和行为自然。 与任务忠诚有关的奖励使用基于LLM的法官(Zheng等,2023年),例如通过评价模拟对话传达任务意图所指定信息的程度. 我们发现LLM-as-a-判断行为自然性不能可靠地鼓励现实的用户行为. 相反,我们利用对抗性训练(Goodfellow等,2014年b)及其对对话生成的应用(Li等,2017年),提议对行为自然性给予歧视者奖励。 具体而言,我们不断重新培训歧视者,以区分真正的用户对话与正在培训的用户模拟器所产生的对话。 这种选择定义了自然的奖励,从一个特定的模拟对话如何与真正的用户对话无法区分的角度. 随着模拟器的演进,我们更新了歧视者,以使自然奖励能够顺应其不断变化的产出,并减少利用固定评价员的机会(Gao等,2022年)。

blocks.en: We train, evaluate, and release the resulting artifact, UserLM-2.0. Among the simulators we evaluated, UserLM-2.0 lies on the Pareto frontier for task fidelity and behavioral naturalness. We count a simulated conversation as valid if it adheres to our quality and termination criteria, achieves at least 80% coverage of the task intent and passes our naturalness criterion, assessed using three discriminators including Pangram ( Glickenhaus et al., 2026 ) . By this definition, UserLM-2.0 yields valid conversations for 46.2% of task intents, more than three times the 14.1% rate of the strongest prior user simulator (SFTUser-14B). This gap grows even further to a factor of 12 at higher task complexities, highlighting the effectiveness of our method.
blocks.zh: 我们训练,评估,并释放 由此产生的文物,UserLM -2.0。 在我们所评价的模拟器中,UserLM-2.0位于帕雷托边疆,用于任务忠实和行为自然. 如果模拟对话符合我们的质量和终止标准,至少达到任务意图的80%,并通过我们的自然性标准,使用包括Pangram(Glickenhaus等人,2026年)在内的三个歧视者来评估,我们就认为模拟对话是有效的。 根据这一定义,UserLM-2.0对46.2%的任务意向产生有效对话,是最强的前用户模拟器(SFTUSer-14B)的14.1%的三倍多. 这一差距在任务复杂程度更高的12个因素中进一步扩大,突出了我们的方法的有效性。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: Our goal is to train a user simulator that takes a high-level task intent as input, and simulates realistic user utterances in a multi-turn user-assistant conversation. As previously discussed, a good user simulator must (1) generate natural utterances, and (2) obey the task intents closely.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是训练一个以高级任务意图作为输入的用户模拟器,并在一个多回合的用户协助对话中模拟现实的用户言论. 如前所讨论,一个好的用户模拟器必须 (1) 生成自然语句,并 (2) 严格遵守任务意图.

blocks.en: 2.1 Problem Definition
blocks.zh: 2.1 问题定义

blocks.en: Each conversation is a multi-turn interaction where a user simulator U U interacts with an assistant model A A to satisfy an input intent c c . This intent c c captures the high-level goal of the user without detailing behavior on a turn-by-turn basis. Given c c , we sample conversations τ = ( c , u 1 , a 1 , … , u n − 1 , a n − 1 , u n ) \tau=(c,u_{1},a_{1},\ldots,u_{n-1},a_{n-1},u_{n}) , where u i u_{i} and a i a_{i} represent the sampled i i -th user and assistant utterances respectively. A conversation terminates either when the maximum number of user turns N N is reached or when the user outputs an <|endconversation|> tag.

blocks.en:
Prior work ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Naous et al., 2026 ) trains user simulators via SFT on a large corpus of user-assistant interactions.
These exhibit the desired naturalness behavior, but are extremely poor at faithfully enacting task intents.
We propose treating such SFT models as initializations rather than the final user simulator. We train our own SFT model, UserLM-2.0-SFT, and design an RL-based post-training pipeline that improves its task fidelity without sacrificing naturalness.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作(Wang等,2025;Naous等,2026)通过SFT培训用户模拟器,进行大量用户-协助者互动.
这些展现出人们所期望的自然行为,但是在忠实地制定任务意图时却极其糟糕.
我们建议将这种SFT模型视为初始化,而不是最终用户模拟器. 我们训练自己的SFT模型,UserLM-2.0-SFT,并设计一个基于RL的后训练管,在不牺牲自然的情况下改进其任务忠实性.

blocks.en:
We perform multi-turn reinforcement learning using the GRPO algorithm ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Our reward balances the above two goals of user simulation, task fidelity and behavioral naturalness.
Although these are orthogonal, models can easily reward hack one at the cost of the other, such as by unnaturally including all information in the first utterance for perfect task coverage. The combined reward composition safeguards against such behaviors.
blocks.zh:
我们使用GRPO算法(Shao等,2024年)进行多回合强化学习. 我们的奖励平衡了以上两个目标:用户模拟,任务忠诚和行为自然.
虽然这些是正交的,但模型可以很容易地以另一个的代价奖励一个黑客,例如不自然地将所有信息都包含在第一个语音中,以便完美地覆盖任务. 综合奖励构成对这种行为的保障。

blocks.en: 2.2 Reward Design For Reinforcement Learning
blocks.zh: 2.2 强化学习奖励设计

blocks.en: We first describe the individual reward components and then our formula for combining them:
blocks.zh: 我们首先描述了奖励的个别组成部分,然后我们结合这些组成部分的公式:

blocks.en:
The naturalness reward should score how closely the user utterances of simulated conversation resemble the way real users interact with AI assistants in a target corpus.
Let P disc P_{\text{disc}} be a discriminator that can distinguish between real and simulated user utterances. Our naturalness reward measures how well the user simulator fools such a discriminator based on P disc ​ ( y = real ∣ u 1 ^ ​ … ​ u k ^ , c ) P_{\text{disc}}(y=\text{real}\mid\hat{u_{1}}...\hat{u_{k}},c) , where u 1 ^ ​ … ​ u k ^ \hat{u_{1}}...\hat{u_{k}} is the multi-turn output from the user simulator and c c is the associated task intent. For training, we set our naturalness reward to be binary; it is 1 1 if this discriminator score is above a threshold ( 0.5 0.5 in our experiments) and 0 0 otherwise.

blocks.en:
Broadly, we have two options for discriminators: LLM judges or specially trained discriminators. LLM judges are ill-suited for this task. Naturalness captures multiple implicit dimensions such as the surface-form of the utterance, pace of the conversation, coherence of follow-up utterances, etc., all of which might be impossible to extract from the target corpus and enumerate as instructions.
In fact, prior work ( Russell et al., 2025 ) has shown that prompted LLM judges are ineffective at distinguishing between real user and AI text. 1 1 1 Note that AI detection of assistant turns is an analogous task to user naturalness. There, the goal is to score the “naturalness” of AI assistants’ text to distinguish it from human-written text. We highlight that the best AI detectors in industry use trained discriminators instead of LLM judges ( Glickenhaus et al., 2026 ) . In our work, we train lightweight discriminators on top of ModernBert-Large ( Warner et al., 2025 ) to distinguish between real and simulated user utterances. This allows us to both limit the costs and latency during RL and specialize to the user behaviors in the target corpus. We include ablations to empirically demonstrate the issues with using LLM judges and static discriminators in Section 4.4 .
blocks.zh:
一般而言,我们对歧视者有两种选择:法学硕士法官或受过专门培训的歧视者。 LLM法官不适合执行这项任务。 自然性捕捉到多种隐含的维度,如言语的表面形式,对话的速度,后续语句的一致性等,所有这些维度都可能无法从目标体中取出并被列举为指示.
事实上,先前的作品(Russell等,2025年)已经表明被激发的LLM评委对于区分真实用户和AI文本无效. 1个 1,注意AI检测助手转弯是类似用户自然性的任务. 因此,目标是对AI助手文本的 " 自然性 " 进行评分,以区别于人文文本。 我们强调,业界最好的AI探测器使用训练有素的歧视者,而不是LLM法官(Glickenhaus等,2026年)。 在我们的作品中,我们培训了"现代伯特-Large"(Warner等,2025年)上方的轻量级歧视者,以区分真实的和模拟的用户言论. 这使得我们既能限制RL期间的成本和耐久性,又能专门处理目标体中的用户行为. 我们包括在第4.4节中使用LLM法官和静态歧视者的经验性演示问题。

blocks.en: This reward component quantifies how completely the user simulator follows a task intent. We define coverage as the proportion of the sub-goals of the task intent that are included in the user utterances generated by the simulator. This is instantiated with an LLM judge.
blocks.zh: 这个奖励组件可以量化用户模拟器如何完全遵循任务意图. 我们把覆盖范围定义为模拟器生成的用户言论中包含的任务意图次级目标的比例。 这是与LLM法官的即时报道。

blocks.en: We highlight that coverage can be an easy metric to reward hack for user simulators. For example, given a detailed task intent with fully specified sub-goals, a user simulator can maximize coverage by simply paraphrasing the sub-goals. This is not ideal as it disincentivizes diverse simulations for the same task intent. Therefore, we introduce an information asymmetry between the task intent provided to the user simulator as input ( c c ) and the one used to compute the coverage reward by the LLM judge ( c ∗ c^{*} ), where c c is a more abstract version of the fully-specified task intent c ∗ c^{*} . This ensures the model receives poor coverage when simply paraphrasing, and encourages exploring more diverse behaviors.
blocks.zh: 我们强调,对于用户模拟器来说,覆盖是一个简单的衡量标准。 例如,鉴于详细的任务意图和充分指定的次级目标,一个用户模拟器可以仅通过解释次级目标而最大限度地扩大覆盖面。 这不理想,因为这样会为同样的任务意图而使不同的模拟失去动力. 因此,我们引入了作为输入(cc)提供给用户模拟器的任务意向与用于计算LLM法官的覆盖奖励(c * * * * * *)之间的信息不对称,其中c是完整指定的任务意向的更抽象版本c * c * * * * * . 这确保了模型在简单地解释时的覆盖率低,并鼓励探索更加多样化的行为.

blocks.en: In addition to coverage, we include two other reward components for task fidelity. These target proper formatting of the user utterances and elimination of trivial failure modes of the SFT models.
blocks.zh: 除了覆盖范围以外,我们还包括对任务忠诚的另外两个奖励部分。 这些目标是正确格式化用户的言论,并消除SFT模式的微小故障模式。

blocks.en: Our quality reward is a binary score that assesses the baseline quality of a simulated conversation. It targets three common error modes of the SFT models: (1) verbatim repetition of task intent, (2) verbatim repetition of past user turns, and (3) switching roles from user to assistant mid-output. We first check the initial two conditions programmatically and otherwise use an LLM judge. A simulated conversation is given a reward 1 1 if all three conditions are met, and 0 0 otherwise.
blocks.zh: 我们的质量奖励是二进制的分数,用来评估模拟对话的基准质量. 它针对SFT模型的三种常见出错模式:(1)任务意图的逐字重复,(2)过去用户转弯的逐字重复,(3)角色从用户切换到助理中产出. 我们首先从程序上检查最初的两个条件,否则就使用LLM法官。 如果满足了所有三个条件,模拟谈话会获得1分奖励,另0分奖励.

blocks.en: The goal of the termination reward is to ensure that user simulators properly terminate conversations when all sub-goals in c ∗ c^{*} are met and penalize early termination. We give a positive reward λ \lambda for including the termination tag <|endconversation|> in the last utterance if all sub-goals have been met in the earlier utterances and a negative reward − λ -\lambda if the conversation is terminated without satisfying all sub-goals. Note that this ties the termination reward to coverage. In some cases, the user simulator fails to terminate the conversation at all, i.e. does not generate the <|endconversation|> tag; in these cases, we give it a 0 0 termination reward.

blocks.en: 2.3 GAN-Style Training with Dynamic Discriminators
blocks.zh: 2.3 GAN -- -- 动态歧视者系统培训

blocks.en: One limitation of trained naturalness discriminators, especially lightweight ones with fewer parameters, is that a larger user simulator trained against it will quickly learn to reward hack. It will quickly converge on a narrow set of behaviors that reliably fools the specific discriminator but does not learn broader behavioral naturalness. Our initial experiments validated this intuition – user simulators trained against a static discriminator maximized the naturalness reward within 75 steps by greatly increasing average utterance length while reducing conversation turns.
blocks.zh: 训练有素的自然歧视者,尤其是参数较少的轻量级者,其一个局限性是,训练有素的用户模拟器会很快学会奖励黑客. 它很快会聚集在一套狭义的行为上,这些行为可靠地愚弄了具体的歧视者,但不会学习更广泛的行为自然性. 我们最初的实验验证了这种直觉 — — 接受过静态歧视者训练的用户模拟器在75个步骤内通过大幅提高平均说出时间,同时减少对话的转折,使自然回报最大化。

blocks.en: To address this, we propose a GAN-style training recipe that periodically re-trains the discriminator every k steps. This improves discriminator quality by exposing it to synthetic conversations with distinct behavioral patterns and further helps detect and discourage reward hacking behavior.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们提出一种GAN式的培训方法,定期重新检查歧视者的每一千步。 这提高了歧视者的质量,使其接触到具有不同行为模式的合成对话,并进一步帮助发现并阻止奖励黑客行为.

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset Construction

blocks.en:
We run our experiments on the non-toxic subset of WildChat-4.8M ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) .
We build on top of the dataset processing scheme of Naous et al. (2026) , additionally removing interactions with only one user turn as our goal is to simulate multi-turn interactions. This reduces the WildChat-4.8M dataset size from 3,199,860 to 199,249 interactions.
We also follow Naous et al. (2026) in how we construct train, validation and test sets.
We hold out 10,000 and 1,000 conversations from the train and validation set for RL training, 3,200 and 1,000 conversations from the train and validation set for discriminator training, and use the rest for SFT. Refer to Appendix A for more details on dataset construction.

blocks.en: 3.2 Training Details
blocks.zh: 3.2 培训细节

blocks.en: We use Llama3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) as the backbone for UserLM-2.0. We replicate the SFT training of Naous et al. (2026) and select the checkpoint with the best validation loss for subsequent RL. This checkpoint is UserLM-2.0-SFT. For RL, we simulate conversations with a maximum turn count of N = 5 N=5 , and use Qwen3.5-9B without reasoning ( Team, 2026 ) as the assistant model. We set λ = 0.2 \lambda=0.2 for the termination reward, batch size to 64 64 , group size to 8 8 and KL hyperparameter β = 0.001 \beta=0.001 . We measure model performance on the validation set every 25 25 steps for checkpoint selection. See Appendix B for further training details.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Llama3.1-8B-Instruct(Grattafiori等,2024年)作为用户LM-2.0的主干. 我们复制了Naous等人(2026年)的SFT训练,并选择了最优的检查站损失,用于后续的RL. 这个检查站是UserLM-2.0-SFT. 对于RL,我们模拟对话时最大转数为N = 5 N = 5,并使用Quen3.5-9B而不进行推理(Team, 2026)作为助手模型. 我们规定 = 0.2\lambda=0.2 解雇奖励,批量大小为 64 64, 组员大小为 8 8, KL 高参数 β = 0.001\β = 0.001。 我们用每25个步骤的验证来测量模式性能 见附录 关于进一步培训详情的B。

blocks.en: We use the 395M ModernBERT-Large ( Warner et al., 2025 ) as the discriminator. For each task intent, we sample one simulated conversation (using the user and assistant models) and one real conversation (from the ground truth dataset). 2 2 2 We use only the user turns for discrimination, as we found including assistant turns made simulated conversations perfectly discriminable due to stylistic differences between assistants. This ensures that our dataset is always balanced. We re-train our discriminator every 25 25 steps of RL training. At each iteration, half of our training dataset consists of conversations based on task intents from the most recent 25 25 RL steps, while the other half is sampled uniformly from the remaining training history. We train for five epochs and pick the checkpoint achieving the best validation accuracy. Refer to Appendix B.3 for exact hyperparameters and training details.
blocks.zh: 我们使用395M ModernBERT-Large(Warner等,2025年)作为歧视者. 对于每项任务意图,我们抽取一个模拟对话(使用用户和助理模型)和一个真实对话(从地面真理数据集). 2,2,我们只使用用户转而歧视,因为我们发现包括助理转而制作的模拟对话,由于助理之间的风格差异,完全可以歧视. 这确保了我们的数据集总是平衡的。 我们每25个阶段的RL训练 都会重新训练歧视者 在每集培训中,我们一半的培训数据集包括基于最近25个RL步骤的任务意图的对话,而另一半则统一取自其余的培训历史。 我们为五个时代训练 并选择检查点 达到最好的验证准确性。 准确的超参数和培训细节,见附录B.3。

blocks.en: 3.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: 3.3 基线

blocks.en: We compare UserLM-2.0  against two categories of models: assistant LLMs prompted to behave like users, and specialized finetuned user simulators, as well as held out reference users.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了UserLM-2.0和两类模型: 助理LLMs被激发到像用户一样的行为,以及专业的微调用户模拟器,以及牵出参考用户.

UserLM-8B and SFTUser-14B are trained on WildChat-1M ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) via SFT but differ in their backbone initialization. USP is also SFT-trained but on a subset of 94,874 LMSys-Chat conversations ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) . We use the HumanLM-Opinion checkpoint as other HumanLM checkpoints have not been released. For USP and HumanLM-Opinion, we include the input intent and termination instructions in system prompts (details in Appendix C.1 ).

Specifically, we evaluate: Llama3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) (Llama-3.1-8B in the tables), Qwen3.5-9B ( Team, 2026 ) , GPT-5.6-Luna, GPT-5.6-Sol ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , DeepSeek-V4-Pro ( Xu et al., 2026 ) and Kimi-K2.6 ( Moonshot AI, 2026 ) . blocks.en: 3.4 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.4 评价计量

blocks.en: We evaluate all simulators on a common set of 2,000 test task intents. For each task intent, we simulate four independent conversations and compute three evaluation metrics that assess task fidelity and three metrics that assess naturalness. Finally, we define a compound metric that assesses the overall validity of each simulated conversation.
blocks.zh: 我们用2000个测试任务意图来评估所有模拟器。 对于每项任务的意图,我们模拟4个独立对话,并计算三个评估度量,以评估任务是否忠实,以及三个评估自然性的度量。 最后,我们定义了一个复合度量衡,用以评估每次模拟对话的总体有效性.

blocks.en: We assess each generated conversation by reusing the Terminated, Quality, and Coverage as defined in Section 2.2 . In short, Terminated is the percentage of conversations with an explicit <|endconversation|> present. The Quality metric is a binary check for three undesirable behaviors (e.g., verbatim copying of the task intent in a single user utterance). For the evaluation, we used Qwen3.5-9B as the LLM judge for Quality, and the stronger GPT-5.6-Luna for Coverage, as we found this additional model capacity allowed to extract additional per-turn information about intent coverage.
blocks.zh: 我们通过重新使用第2.2节所定义的终止、质量和覆盖范围来评估每次对话。 简而言之,终止是指有明确“结束对话”在场的对话的百分比。 质量度量衡是对三种不良行为的二进制检查(例如,将任务意图逐一复制在单一用户的语音中). 对于评价,我们使用Quen3.5-9B作为质量的LLM评分,以及更强的GPT-5.6-Luna覆盖,因为我们发现这种额外的模型能力允许获取更多关于意向覆盖的倒转信息.

blocks.en: We report naturalness using three complementary discriminators. We trained the first two discriminators in analogous ways to discriminators trained in Section 3.2 . Both use ModernBert-Large as the base.

2. Naturalness-General: We train a general discriminator on data from all simulators, which includes our models, baselines from § 3 , and experiments with reward design alternatives in § 4.4 .
This discriminator is generally less strict than the previous one, as it must distinguish between simulations from multiple distributions.

blocks.en: 4.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 主要成果

blocks.en: We present summarized evaluation metrics for task fidelity, naturalness, validity, and estimated simulation costs for UserLM-2.0 and baselines in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们总结了对任务可靠性、自然性、有效性以及UserLM-2.0和基线的估计模拟成本的评价指标。

blocks.en:
Comparing prompted assistants and finetuned user simulators. A general pattern emerges visually in Table 1 . Prompted assistants tend to achieve high coverage scores, but struggle to generate natural conversations.
For example, the best prompted assistant (GPT-5.6-Sol) achieves a naturalness pass rate of only 10.2%.
In contrast, most finetuned user simulators generally perform worse on coverage, but achieve much higher naturalness pass rates. UserLM-2.0 achieves optimal performance on both: it achieves the highest performance among simulators on coverage (88.0%) and naturalness pass rate (71.8%).
blocks.zh:
比较提示助手和微调用户模拟器. 表1显示了一种一般模式。 被催化的助手往往能达到高覆盖率的分数,但努力生成自然的对话.
例如,最佳诱导助手(GPT-5.6-Sol)的自然传入率只有10.2%.
相形之下,大多数微调的用户模拟器在覆盖率上一般表现更差,但能实现高得多的自然通关率. UserLM-2.0在两个方面都实现了最佳性能:在覆盖度(88.0%)和自然通率(71.8%)的模拟器中实现了最高性能.

blocks.en:
UserLM-2.0 generates the highest proportion of valid simulations, outperforming the next-best model by 18.4 % \bm{18.4\%} . UserLM-2.0 achieves an overall validity score of 46.2%, which is 1.66 times as much as the next-best model (our finetuned UserLM-2.0-SFT, at a validity score of 27.8%) and 3.28 times as much as the best previously released user simulator (SFTUser-14B, at 14.1%). This means that, on average, UserLM-2.0  typically requires sampling two conversations to produce a valid one, when previous models required sampling at least 6, and often more than 15.
This, coupled with the small parameter count of UserLM-2.0, leads it to be the most cost-effective user simulator, costing $0.11 to generate 100 valid conversations, compared to $205.20 with GPT-5.6-Sol.
blocks.zh:
UserLM-2.0生成有效模拟中最高的比例,比下等最佳模型的性能高出18.4%\bm{18.4}. UserLM-2.0实现总体有效性分46.2%,是下等最佳模型(我们的微调UserLM-2.0-SFT,有效性分27.8%)的1.66倍,是以前发布的最佳用户模拟器(SFTuser-14B,14.1%)的3.28倍. 这意味着,平均来说,UserLM-2.0通常需要采样两次对话才能产生有效的对话,而以前的模型至少需要采样6次,而且往往超过15次。
这与UserLM-2.0的小参数计数一起,使它成为最具成本效益的用户模拟器,花费了0.11美元生成100个有效对话,而GPT-5.6-Sol则花费了205.20美元.

blocks.en: A large gap remains between simulated and real human–AI conversations. The real, held-out human-AI conversations have perfect naturalness and near-perfect coverage, a 28.2% and 8.0% lead over the best user simulator (UserLM-2.0) on the two metrics respectively. This puts our results in perspective: UserLM-2.0 represents a significant step forward in user simulation, but there remains a substantial gap for future work to close. In particular, our RL-based methodology leads to a large improvement in the task fidelity of the initial SFT checkpoint without sacrificing its naturalness. However, improving beyond this initial naturalness to close the gap to real conversations remains an open challenge. Beyond the model artifact we release, we hope our evaluation methodology emphasizing validity of individual interactions can support future research in user simulation.
blocks.zh: 模拟和真实的人类-AI对话之间还有很大差距。 真实的、被搁置的人工智能对话具有完美的自然性和近乎完美的覆盖面,在两个指标上分别领先28.2%和8.0%的最佳用户模拟器(UserLM-2.0)。 这使得我们的结果有了正确的认识:用户LM-2.0代表了用户模拟方面向前迈出了一大步,但未来工作仍然有很大的差距需要弥合. 特别是,我们基于RL的方法在不牺牲最初的SFT检查站的自然性的情况下,大大改善了该检查站的任务可靠性。 然而,超越这种最初的自然性,缩小差距,进行真正的对话,仍然是一个公开的挑战。 除了我们公布的模型外,我们希望我们强调个人互动有效性的评估方法能够支持今后在用户模拟方面的研究。

blocks.en: 4.2 Stress Testing Under Increasing Task Complexity
blocks.zh: 4.2 在任务日益复杂的情况下进行压力测试

blocks.en: Setup. The key use-case for user simulators is supporting downstream evaluation and training. In particular, a user simulator must be capable of simulating realistic and valid interactions as task complexity varies. For evaluation purposes, we decomposed each test task intent into a set of subgoals : units of information that are part of the task intent. We argue that the number of subgoals of a task intent roughly correlates with task complexity, as more subgoals typically require longer conversation to convey, leading to more opportunity for user simulators to omit or contradict task information. As a first analysis, we break down the performance of user simulators as the number of subgoals increases. Table 2 reports coverage, naturalness pass rate, and overall validity against different levels of task intent complexity. We include similar tables for quality, termination, and individual naturalness scores in Appendix D.1 .
blocks.zh: 设相. 用户模拟器的关键用途是支持下游的评价和培训。 特别是,随着任务复杂程度的不同,用户模拟器必须能够模拟现实而有效的相互作用. 为了评价目的,我们把每项测试任务的意图分解成一套次级目标:构成任务意图一部分的信息单位。 我们争辩说,一项任务意图的次级目标的数目大致与任务的复杂性有关,因为更多的次级目标通常需要较长的谈话才能传达,从而使用户模拟者有更多的机会省略或与任务信息相矛盾。 首先,随着次级目标数量的增加,我们分解了用户模拟器的性能. 表2对照不同级别的任务意向复杂程度报告覆盖面、自然通过率和总体有效性。 我们在附录D.1中列出了类似的质量、终止和个人自然性分数表。

blocks.en: UserLM-2.0 maintains the highest validity across all task-complexity levels. The proportion of valid simulations generally declines as task complexity increases, but UserLM-2.0 leads all evaluated simulators at every level. At five sub-goals, it achieves 36.6% validity, compared with 11.3% for UserLM-2.0-SFT. At six and seven sub-goals, UserLM-2.0 retains validity rates of 23.6% and 12.6%, compared to below 1% for every prior simulator.
blocks.zh: 用户LM-2.0在所有任务复杂级别保持最高有效性. 有效模拟的比例一般会随着任务复杂性的增加而下降,但UserLM-2.0领导着每个级别上的所有被评价的模拟器. 在5个次级目标中,其有效性为36.6%,而用户LM-2.0-SFT为11.3%。 在6个和7个次级目标中,用户LM-2.0保留了23.6%和12.6%的有效性率,而以前每个模拟器的有效期都低于1%。

blocks.en: Table 2: Stress testing by number of task subgoals (1–7). We report mean Coverage, Naturalness Pass Rate (Naturalness Pass %), and overall Validity. Validity additionally requires quality and termination criteria. Scores are rounded to whole percentages.
blocks.zh: 表2:按任务次级目标(1-7)数目分列的压力测试。 我们报告的是覆盖面、自然传出率(自然传出率%)和总体有效性。 有效性还需要质量和终止标准。 得分按四舍五入到整个百分比。

blocks.en: Strong coverage alone does not ensure valid simulations. UserLM-2.0 achieves near-perfect coverage for single-sub-goal tasks (99.4%) and the highest coverage among simulators for tasks with more than three sub-goals (Table 2 ). At seven sub-goals, it retains 79.4% coverage, compared with 78.0% for GPT-5.6-Luna, the strongest prompted assistant in this bucket, and 58.9% for UserLM-2.0-SFT. Yet GPT-5.6-Luna produces no valid simulations in this bucket, versus 12.6% for UserLM-2.0, illustrating why coverage and naturalness provide complementary views of performance.
blocks.zh: 仅靠强覆盖范围并不能确保有效的模拟。 用户LM-2.0实现了单一次级目标任务的近乎完美的覆盖(99.4%),并且是模拟器中拥有三个以上次级目标的任务的最高覆盖(表2)。 在7个次级目标中,它保留了79.4%的覆盖率,而GPT-5.6-Luna的覆盖率为78.0%,而GPT-5.6-Luna是这一桶中最强的激励助手,而UserLM-2.0-SFT的覆盖率为58.9%。 然而,GPT-5.6-Luna在这一桶中并没有产生有效的模拟,而UserLM-2.0的模拟率为12.6%,说明了为什么覆盖范围和自然性提供了互补的性能观点。

blocks.en: 4.3 Behavioral Analysis of Simulators
blocks.zh: 4.3 模拟器的行为分析

blocks.en: Table 3: Repetition and verbosity of user simulators. We report the rate of goal revisitation (Revisit), repetition-only turns (Rep. Only), goalless turns that do not advance the task intent (Emp.), and median user words per covered goal (W/goal). Rates are percentages; darker shading indicates closer agreement with humans for each metric.
blocks.zh: 表3:用户模拟器的重复和动词. 我们报告目标重访率(Revisit),只重复转弯(Rep. Only),不推进任务意图的无目标转弯(Emp.),以及每个覆盖目标(W/goal)的中位用户字. 比率是百分比;更暗的阴影表明,每个度数都更接近人类。

blocks.en: For analysis purposes, we recorded which subgoal is revealed at which turn of simulated test conversations, offering a granular turn-by-turn signal to compare simulated conversation dynamics with real conversations. This allows us to perform three targeted analyses of simulator behavior in terms of repetition, verbosity, and turn dynamics.
blocks.zh: 为了分析的目的,我们记录了哪些子目标被揭示,即模拟测试对话的转动,提供一个颗粒形转动信号来将模拟对话动态与真实对话进行比较。 这使得我们能对模拟者的行为进行三次有针对性的分析,从重复性,动词性,和转动动力学的角度.

blocks.en: Table 3 reports model performance on two repetition and two verbosity metrics (see Appendix C.5 for exact definitions).
blocks.zh: 表3报告了两个重复和两个动词度量的模型性能(确切定义见附录C.5)。

blocks.en: Repetition. First off, human reference conversations tend to include a non-trivial amount of repetition, with 38.8% of subgoals repeated within a conversation, on average, and 33.3% of user turn utterances solely repeating information already provided. We find that UserLM-2.0 nearly matches the rates of information revisiting and repetition of human reference conversation (39.0% and 33.3%), whereas prompted assistants tend to repeat information (41.8–64.9%) and have non-progressing turns (35.8–57.4%) much more frequently.
blocks.zh: 复问. 首先,人类参考对话往往包括非三角重复,平均38.8%的次级目标在对话中重复,33.3%的用户只重复已经提供的信息。 我们发现,UserLM-2.0几乎与人类参考对话重温和重复的信息率(39.0%和33.3%)相符,而诱导助理往往重复信息(41.8-64.9%),而且转折(35.8-57.4%)更为频繁。

blocks.en: Verbosity. We label a turn as Empty if it does not cover any subgoal. Such empty turns are relatively rare in real user conversations (6.9%) but are much more common in most finetuned simulators 18.6–50.5%, indicative of the tendency of finetuned simulators to go off script. UserLM-2.0 achieves low rates of empty turns (4.3%), comparable to human reference conversations and strong prompted assistants (3.6% for GPT-5.6-Sol). Looking at verbosity, we calculate the median number of words each simulator uses on average to reveal a subgoal (W/goal). Human reference conversations are remarkably concise (34 words/subgoal), 40% less than any simulator we tested. UserLM-2.0-SFT and UserLM-2.0 use a median of 54 and 59 words, respectively, significantly lower than all other simulators (77–315 words per subgoal). Thus, though UserLM-2.0 represents significant progress in terms of lowered verbosity, there remains a large gap with real users.
blocks.zh: 华相相. 如果一个转弯没有涵盖任何次级目标,我们就标为 " 空 " 。 这种空转在真实的用户对话中相对罕见(6.9%),但在大多数微调模拟器中更为常见的是18.6–50.5%,表明微调模拟器倾向于去掉脚本. UserLM-2.0实现了低空转速(4.3%),与人类的参考对话相媲美,强势的促动助手(GPT-5.6-Sol为3.6%). 从动词上看,我们计算出每个模拟器平均用来显示一个子目标(W/goal)的中位词数. 人类的参考对话非常简洁(34个字/次级目标),比我们测试过的模拟器少了40%。 用户LM-2.0-SFT和用户LM-2.0分别使用54和59个字的中位数,大大低于所有其他模拟器(每个分目标77-315个字). 因此,虽然用户LM-2.0代表了在降低动词性方面的显著进展,但与真实用户的差距仍然很大.

blocks.en: Goal-disclosure. As a third analysis, we plot coverage progression over time. To enable direct comparisons against human reference conversations, we restrict our focus to conversations with at most six turns. For each turn, we compute the average cumulative coverage and proportion of newly introduced and repeated subgoals at that turn, which we plot in Figure 2 . Several patterns become apparent: first, when compared to human reference conversations, prompted assistants (GPT-5.6-Luna and DeepSeek-V4-Pro) tend to front-load task intent (i.e., reveal a much larger fraction of the entire task intent in the first turn) much more than real conversations (56% coverage at turn one in real conversations, vs. 70-77% for prompted assistants). Second, prompted assistants tend to repeat information excessively, whereas repetition is much sparser in real conversations. Finetuned simulators (UserLM-2.0-SFT and UserLM-8B) do not exhibit the same behavior of overly frontloading and repeating subgoals, but they do so at the cost of not achieving high coverage by the end of the conversation (80% and 68% coverage by end of conversation, respectively), affecting task fidelity and simulation validity. Finally, conversations simulated with UserLM-2.0 resemble real conversations the most in terms of conversation dynamics: less front-loading and repetition of information, while achieving the highest coverage by the end of the conversation (90%).
blocks.zh: 目标公布。 第三个分析是,我们计划一段时间内覆盖进度。 为了能够与人类参考对话进行直接比较,我们把重点限制在最多六个回合的对话上。 对于每一回合,我们计算新提出的和重复的次级目标的平均累积覆盖面和比例,我们在图2中列出。 几种模式变得明显:第一,与人类的参考对话相比,诱导助手(GPT-5.6-Luna和DeepSeek-V4-Pro)倾向于前置任务意图(即,在第一个回合中揭示整个任务意图的更大部分)远远超过了真实对话(在真实对话中,56%的覆盖率,相对于被诱导助手的70-77%). 第二,有动机的助理往往过度重复信息,而重复在真正的对话中则少得多。 微调模拟器(UserLM-2.0-SFT和UserLM-8B)并不表现出过于前置和重复子目标的行为,但它们这样做的代价是在对话结束时没有达到高覆盖率(在对话结束时分别达到80%和68%的覆盖率),影响了任务忠诚性和模拟有效性. 最后,与UserLM-2.0模拟的对话在对话动力学方面最像真实的对话:减少前装和重复信息,同时在对话结束时达到最高覆盖度(90%).

blocks.en: Figure 2: We depict goal disclosure over time for the Human Reference, UserLM-2.0,and prompted and finetuned baselines. Each bar represents the average cumulative coverage at a given conversation turn across sampled conversations. For each turn, the bolded component represents the proportion of newly covered sub-goals, while the gray component represents the proportion of revisited sub-goals. UserLM-2.0 achieves the best alignment with the Human Reference.
blocks.zh: 图 2:我们描绘了随着时间推移的人类参考文献的目标披露,UserLM-2.0,以及激励和微调的基线. 每个栏代表特定对话的累计平均覆盖范围。 在每一回合,大胆部分代表新涵盖的次级目标的比例,而灰色部分则代表重新审视的次级目标的比例。 用户LM-2.0实现与"人文参考"的最佳对接.

blocks.en: 4.4 Reward Design Alternatives
blocks.zh: 4.4 奖励设计替代方案

blocks.en: Table 4: Evaluation results of alternative training strategies. The top three models are trained with alternative reward designs for naturalness. The middle models are either SFT only, or ablate a reward component (Coverage or Naturalness). We report task-fidelity, naturalness and validity metrics.
blocks.zh: 表4:替代培训战略的评价结果。 排名前三位的车型都接受了自然性备选奖励设计的培训. 中间型号要么是仅SFT,要么是放弃奖励成分(Coverage或Naturalness). 我们报告任务可靠性、自然性和有效性的衡量标准。

blocks.en: Choice of naturalness discriminators. First, we explore alternative options for the design of the naturalness reward. We compare the performance of UserLM-2.0, trained with a dynamic discriminator, against the following choices: (i) Fixed Discriminator, trained only once at the beginning of RL, (ii) LLM Judge - Likert, which prompts an LLM-judge to score naturalness on a Likert scale of 1 to 5, (iii) LLM Judge - Winrate, which prompts the judge to select between a model-generated conversation and its corresponding ground-truth variant and uses the resulting winrate as the reward. Refer to Appendix B.4 for details.
blocks.zh: 自然歧视者的选择。 首先,我们探索自然奖励设计的其他选择。 我们比较了UserLM-2.0与动态歧视者所训练的性能与以下选择: (一)固定歧视者,在RL开始时只培训过一次; (二)LLM法官-Import,它促使LLM法官以1至5的相像度来评分自然度; (三)LLM法官-Winrate,它促使法官在模式产生的对话与其相应的地-事实变体之间作出选择并使用由此得到的折叠度作为奖励. 详见附录B.4。

blocks.en: Table 4 reports task-fidelity, naturalness, and validity metrics for all discriminator options. Our results show that dynamic discriminators are necessary for achieving high naturalness. UserLM-2.0, trained with the dynamic discriminator, outperforms all naturalness alternatives by a large margin. We find that the Fixed Disc. alternative reports the lowest naturalness pass rate of any discriminator. Manual inspection of conversations revealed that this user simulator converges to a narrow range of word- and turn-counts that consistently fools the frozen discriminator but does not reflect true naturalness. Lastly, neither user simulator trained with LLM-judge based discriminators come close to UserLM-2.0’s naturalness. This is unsurprising as naturalness is a distributional property of a corpus which is difficult for LLM-judges to infer based on a few exemplars or instructions.
blocks.zh: 表4报告所有歧视选择的任务可靠性、自然性和有效性衡量标准。 我们的结果显示,动态歧视者是实现高自然度所必需的。 UserLM-2.0在动态歧视者的培训下,以很大的比例超越了所有的自然性替代品. 我们发现,固定的Disc 替代报告 任何歧视者的自然度通过率最低。 对对话的人工检查显示,这个用户模拟器与狭义的字数和转数汇合在一起,这些字数和转数始终愚弄被冻结的歧视者,但不反映真实的自然性. 最后,受过LLM法官培训的用户模拟器都没有接近UserLM-2.0的自然性。 这一点并不奇怪,因为自然是一物的分布财产,LLM法官很难根据几个实例或指示推断。

blocks.en: Second, we train separate models that remove the naturalness reward (W/o Naturalness) or the coverage reward (W/o Coverage). Since the termination reward described in § 2.2 explicitly captures coverage, we also omit it when training the W/o Coverage model. All other reward components remain unchanged.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们培训单独的模式,取消自然奖励(W/o自然)或覆盖奖励(W/o覆盖)。 由于第2.2节所述的终止奖励明确涵盖范围,我们在培训W/o覆盖模式时也省略了。 所有其他奖励部分保持不变。

blocks.en: The middle block of Table 4 reports on these ablations. Both removing naturalness and jointly removing coverage and termination reduce validity. Neither ablated model matches the validity score of UserLM-2.0. This reflects the requirement that valid simulations satisfy both task-fidelity and naturalness criteria.
blocks.zh: 表4的中间部分报告了这些事件。 既去除自然性,又联合去除覆盖和终止,都降低了有效性. 两者均不符合UserLM-2.0的有效性分. 这反映了有效模拟必须满足任务可靠性和自然性两个标准的要求。

blocks.en: The removal of the naturalness reward (W/o Naturalness) lowers the rate at which the model fools any discriminator (42.0% vs 71.8% for the full UserLM-2.0). The W/o Coverage model retains a high naturalness pass rate (81.2%), but achieves poor overall validity due to task-fidelity metrics (19.0% vs 46.2% for the full model). This limits its joint validity despite its naturalness. In the component-level task-fidelity evaluations, this model reports a poor Terminated score that checks for the <|endconversation|> tag. A seemingly counterintuitive result is that it still reports high mean coverage. However, recall that our naturalness reward also indirectly captures coverage. The naturalness discriminators during training (see § 2.2 ) condition on the task intents c c and are therefore likely to learn to reward conversations that satisfy them, as this behavior is exhibited by ground-truth conversations.
blocks.zh: 自然奖励(W/o Naturality)的去除降低了模型愚弄任何歧视者的比率(全用户LM-2.0的42.0%对71.8%). W/o覆盖模型保留了高自然度及格率(81.2%),但由于任务真实性衡量标准(全模型为19.0%对46.2%),总体有效性较差。 这限制了其共同有效性,尽管其自然性。 在组件级的任务可靠性评价中,这个模型报告一个差的终止分数,检查了‘endconveration'的标签. 一种似乎适得其反的结果是,它仍然报告说,它的覆盖率很低。 然而,回顾一下,我们的自然回报也间接地捕捉到覆盖。 培训期间的自然歧视者(见第2.2节)以任务c为条件,因此有可能学习奖励满足他们的谈话,因为这种行为通过地面-真相对话来表现。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion & Implications
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和影响

blocks.en: We first note that our existing metrics are imperfect, as human reference conversations do not achieve perfect scores on Quality or Coverage. Nonetheless, the human references still strongly outperform all simulators, including UserLM-2.0, on these metrics, despite our training directly optimizing these metrics. According to our framework, more than 80% of reference conversations are valid in terms of task fidelity and naturalness. This is more than 30% above UserLM-2.0, a gap roughly as large as the gain between the previously best simulator and UserLM-2.0 (14.1% to 46.2%). We believe that further innovation and scaling in the RL recipes could yield further gains on the metrics within our framework, delivering state-of-the-art user simulators. In other words, we believe the gap in metrics that remains in our framework is significant and invite the community to close the gap to develop improved user simulators.
blocks.zh: 我们首先指出,我们现有的衡量标准是不完善的,因为人类参考对话在质量或覆盖面方面没有达到完美的分数。 尽管如此,尽管我们的培训直接优化了这些衡量标准,但是在这些指标上,包括UserLM-2.0在内的所有模拟器的人类参考文献仍然表现得非常好。 根据我们的框架,80%以上的参考谈话在任务忠实和自然方面是有效的。 这比UserLM-2.0高出了30%以上,与以前最好的模拟器和UserLM-2.0之间的增益(14.1%至46.2%)差距大致相同. 我们认为,进一步创新和扩大RL配方,可在我们框架内的衡量标准方面取得进一步成果,提供最先进的用户模拟器。 换句话说,我们认为我们框架中仍然存在的衡量标准差距很大,因此请社区缩小差距来开发改进的用户模拟器。

blocks.en: One surprising finding from our alternative reward design experiments (Section 4.4 ) is that several formulations of naturalness rewards lead to worse naturalness performance than no naturalness reward at all. More specifically, we found that evaluating naturalness either with an LLM-as-a-judge prompt or using a fixed discriminator trained only once can harm simulator performance by leading to simulations that are more easily distinguishable from real conversations (i.e., less natural). This phenomenon is understandable through the lens of reward hacking: the simulator optimizes for a flawed notion of naturalness, making simulated conversations more easily identifiable and less natural. This finding highlights the importance of the dynamically retrained discriminator of our training framework: we demonstrated empirically that this enables the trained simulators to minimize the gap with a reference corpus of real interactions while preventing reward hacking. We hope this experiment encourages the community to limit the use of LLM-as-a-judge for naturalness evaluation, as we show it is not effective.
blocks.zh: 从我们的备选奖励设计实验(第4.4节)中得出的一个出人意料的发现是,自然奖励的几种表述导致的自然性能比根本没有自然性奖励更差. 更具体地说,我们发现,用LLM-as-a-judge即时评价自然性,或使用只经过一次训练的固定歧视者,可导致比较容易与真实对话相区别的模拟,从而损害模拟器的性能(即不太自然)。 这种现象通过奖励黑客的镜头是可以理解的:模拟器优化了一个有缺陷的自然概念,使模拟对话更容易被识别,更不自然. 这个结论凸显了我们培训框架的动态再培训歧视者的重要性:我们从经验上证明,这可以使训练有素的模拟器在防止奖励黑客的同时,通过真正的互动参考工具,最大限度地缩小差距。 我们希望这项试验能鼓励社区限制使用LLM-as-a-judge来进行自然性评价,因为我们显示它没有效果.

blocks.en: For UserLM-2.0, our training and evaluation intend to simulate conversations from the WildChat-4.8M ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) dataset. WildChat conversations are pure chatbot interactions, with no environment present (such as a file system or access to a computing environment). As agentic interaction with AI-based systems become more prevalent, being able to simulate users not only in pure chat settings but also in agentic settings that involve tools and environments become more important. This can help evaluate not only how users dynamically reveal their intents, but also how they access files, verify task completions from the agent, and how they choose to delegate tasks within a shared environment. Creating such agentic user simulators faces several key challenges, including a lack of diverse data of agentic user-AI interactions. Initial resources such as SWE-chat ( Baumann et al., 2026 ) show a promising path forward that can enable the training of user simulators for agentic settings.
blocks.zh: 对于UserLM-2.0,我们的培训和评价打算模拟来自WildChat-4.8M(赵等,2024年)数据集的对话. WildChat对话是纯粹的聊天人互动,没有环境存在(如文件系统或访问计算环境). 随着与基于AI的系统的代理互动越来越普遍,不仅能够在纯聊天环境中模拟用户,而且在涉及工具和环境的代理环境中模拟用户也变得更为重要. 这不仅可以帮助评价用户如何动态地披露其意图,还可以帮助评价用户如何访问文件,从代理中核实任务完成情况,以及如何选择在共享环境中下放任务. 创建此类代理用户模拟器面临若干关键挑战,包括缺乏代理用户-AI互动的多样化数据. 初始资源如SWE-chat(Baumann等,2026年)显示了一条很有希望的前进道路,能够为代理设置培训用户模拟器.

blocks.en: During training, we made several decisions on the information the naturalness discriminator is conditioned on. Specifically, the discriminator we use sees all user utterances, none of the assistant utterances, and the input task intent for a given simulated conversation. This causes the discriminator to not only assess whether the user utterances are natural in terms of the surface form, but also whether the conversation is a naturalistic enactment of the entire task intent (as real conversations are always full enactments of the task intent). We believe that alternative inputs to the discriminator can define subtly distinct naturalness rewards, which can be combined to produce more robust and well-rounded naturalness rewards for training. For example, one could formulate turn-level or conversation-level discriminators, with or without task intents provided, with or without assistant utterances included. We hope that the community will explore diverse formulations of discriminator conditions, and find effective ways to combine them into robust methods to train natural user simulators.
blocks.zh: 在培训期间,我们就自然歧视者所依据的信息作出了若干决定。 具体地说,我们所用的歧视者看到所有用户的言论,没有一个助手的言论,以及特定模拟对话的输入任务意图. 这使得歧视者不仅要评估用户的言论在表层形式上是否是自然的,而且要评估对话是否是整个任务意图的自然化制定(因为真实的对话总是任务意图的充分制定). 我们认为,对歧视者的其他投入可以界定低等独特的自然奖励,这些奖励可以结合起来,为培训提供更有力、更周全的自然奖励。 例如,可以提出回合或对话一级的歧视者,不论是否提供任务意图,是否包括助理的言论。 我们希望,社区将探索各种歧视条件的提法,并找到有效办法,将这些提法结合起来,成为训练自然用户模拟器的有力方法。

blocks.en: Naturalness is a question of how well a given user simulator aligns with behavior in a target corpus. UserLM-2.0, for instance, is trained by first performing SFT on WildChat-4.8M to align its initial behavior with that of users in the dataset. In realistic settings, simply doing SFT on user data runs the risk of having models regurgitate private information. The development of user simulators should work in tandem with the design of privacy-aware training strategies or methods for generating synthetic data for training that remains naturalistic.
blocks.zh: 自然性是一个问题,一个给定的用户模拟器如何与目标体中的行为保持一致. 例如,用户LM-2.0通过在WildChat-4.8M上首先进行SFT培训,使其初始行为与数据集中的用户行为保持一致. 在现实环境中,仅仅在用户数据上进行SFT就有可能使模型重现私人信息。 开发用户模拟器应与设计了解隐私的培训战略或生成仍属自然性质的综合培训数据的方法相配合。

blocks.en: Our training and evaluation both used Qwen3.5-9B ( Team, 2026 ) as the assistant model that the simulated user interacts with. For a user simulator to be robust, however, it should provide naturalistic responses to both state-of-the-art assistant models, as well as those that perform poorly or inconsistently in a given task. Devising training and evaluation environments that expose user simulators to a broader range of assistant behaviors is a valuable next step.
blocks.zh: 我们的训练和评价都使用Quen3.5-9B(Team,2026)作为模拟用户与之互动的助理模型. 然而,为了使用户模拟器强大,它应对最先进的助理模型以及在某项任务中表现不佳或不一致的模型提供自然主义的反应。 设计培训和评价环境,使用户模拟器接触到更广泛的辅助行为,是下一步的宝贵措施。

blocks.en: Research on user simulators is still nascent, and we currently lack a standardized evaluation methodology. One line of work evaluates simulators by comparing corpus-level statistics of behaviors like turn-counts, turn-lengths, etc. against a corpus of human-AI conversations. These metrics are intuitive and useful for characterizing aggregate behaviors, as shown in our behavioral analysis in Section 4.3 . However, a corpus-level alignment on multiple behaviors independently does not guarantee that individual simulations are usable. For example, consider a simulator that, on aggregate, improves both coverage and naturalness but each generated sample maximizes one at the cost of the other. In this case, no individual sample is usable for downstream use-cases of evaluating or training assistant models. Therefore, in addition to corpus-level metrics, we believe that a simulation-level metric is crucial to establishing simulation readiness. Our validity metric captures this new evaluation principle. In our work, we instantiated it to combine task fidelity and naturalness dimensions, although this exact combination can be altered depending on domain specifications. We hope that future work will evaluate user simulators using both simulation- and corpus-level tests for holistic evaluation.
blocks.zh: 对用户模拟器的研究仍然起步,目前我们缺乏标准化的评价方法. 一行工作通过比较人与AI对话体等行为的实体级统计来评价模拟器. 正如我们在第4.3节的行为分析中所显示的,这些衡量尺度是直观的,对描述综合行为很有用。 然而,对多个行为独立进行实体级的校正并不能保证个人模拟是有用的. 例如,考虑一个模拟器,从总体上讲,它既能提高覆盖率,又能提高自然性,但每个生成的样本都以牺牲另一个样本为代价,尽量扩大一个样本。 在这种情况下,没有单个样本可用于下游评价或培训助理模型。 因此,除了实体层面的衡量标准外,我们认为模拟层面的衡量标准对于建立模拟准备状态至关重要。 我们的有效性衡量标准体现了这一新的评价原则。 在我们的作品中,我们即刻将其结合任务忠诚度和自然度维度,虽然这种精确的组合可以根据域规格来改变. 我们希望今后的工作将利用模拟和体能测试来评价用户模拟器,以便进行全面评价。

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: User Simulation: Early work focused on user simulation as a means to evaluate or train task-oriented dialogue policies ( Eckert et al., 1997 ; Shi et al., 2019 ) , with methods ranging from rule-based systems ( Schatzmann et al., 2007 ) to neural architectures ( Asri et al., 2016 ; Kreyssig et al., 2018 ) . Currently, user simulation is predominantly done using LLM assistants prompted zero-shot to act as users on settings ranging from chatbot interactions ( Li et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) to agentic tasks ( Barres et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . While such simulations benefit from LLMs’ ability to enact specified task intents, they also suffer from poor alignment with human behavior ( Yoon et al., 2024 ; Ivey et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Prior work has separately explored training models to generate user turns in dialogues. This has most commonly been done through finetuning on human-assistant interactions ( Sekulic et al., 2024 ; Naous et al., 2026 ; Suh et al., 2026 ) on datasets such as MultiWOZ and WildChat ( Eric et al., 2020 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) . The resulting models are naturalistic, but also brittle and poor at task-fidelity ( Naous et al., 2026 ) . As a result, recent work has placed emphasis on alignment and consistency with user intents via RL ( Abdulhai et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Mehri et al., 2026b ) . We propose training an SFT initialization using RL to maximize both task fidelity and naturalness, operationalized as fooling a dynamically trained discriminator.
blocks.zh: 用户模拟 : 早期的工作重点是用户模拟,作为评价或培训面向任务的对话政策的一种手段(Eckert等,1997;Shi等,2019),方法从基于规则的系统(Schatzmann等,2007)到神经架构(Asri等,2016;Kreyssig等,2018. 目前,用户模拟主要使用由LLM助手促动的零镜头来作为用户在从chatbot交互(Li等,2024;Wu等,2025)到代理任务(Barres等,2026;Sun等,2026)的设置上发挥作用. 虽然这种模拟得益于LLMs制定特定任务意图的能力,但他们也因与人类行为不一致而受到影响(Yoon等,2024;Ivey等,2026;Zhou等,2026)。 先前的工作分别探索了培训模式,以生成对话中的用户回合. 这通常是通过微调人类与辅助者之间的相互作用来实现的(Sekulic等人,2024;Naous等人,2026;Suh等人,2026)。 由此形成的模型是自然主义的,但是在任务不忠方面也很脆弱和差(Naous等人,2026年)。 因此,最近的工作强调通过RL与用户意图保持一致(Abdulhai等,2025;Wu等,2026;Mehri等,2026b.).。 我们提议培训一个SFT初始化,使用RL,以最大限度地做到任务忠贞和自然,运作起来就是欺骗一个受过动态训练的歧视者。

blocks.en: Evaluation for User Simulators: There is currently no consensus on how to evaluate user simulators ( Pietquin and Hastie, 2013 ; Deriu et al., 2021 ) . One common approach is evaluating similarity to human interactions, which can involve comparisons of user simulator surface-form statistics and stylistic features ( Schatzmann et al., 2005 ; Pietquin and Hastie, 2013 ; Ivey et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) or behavioral patterns ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Mehri et al., 2026a ) against human data. Alternatively, similarity can be assessed by how well user simulators approximate assistant performance with real humans ( Williams, 2008 ; Dou et al., 2025 ; Chang et al., 2025b ) . Other work relies on human judgement as a measure of simulator naturalness ( Shi et al., 2019 ; Sekulić et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . However, this can be expensive and depends on annotators’ ability to detect LLM-generated text ( Russell et al., 2025 ) . In our work, we use state-of-the-art AI-detection models ( Glickenhaus et al., 2026 ) for a generic measure of naturalness. We complement this by also reporting dataset-specific performance with discriminators trained on our target corpus ( Li et al., 2017 ) .
blocks.zh: 用户模拟器的评价 : 目前还没有就如何评价用户模拟器达成共识(Pietquin and Hastie,2013;Deriu等人,2021.). 一种常见的方法是评价与人类相互作用的相似性,这可以涉及将用户模拟器表面形态统计和结构特征进行比较(Schatzmann等,2005年;Pietquin和Hastie,2013年;Ivey等,2026年;周等,2026年)或行为模式(周等,2026年;Mehri等,2026年a)与人类数据进行比较. 另一种办法是,通过用户模拟器对真人助理业绩的大致了解来评估相似性(Williams,2008;Dou等,2025;Chang等,2025b)。 其他作品以人类判断作为模拟自然性的衡量标准(Shi等,2019;Sekulić等,2022;Wu等,2026.). 然而,这可能很昂贵,并取决于注释者检测LLM生成的文本的能力(Russell等,2025年). 在我们的作品中,我们使用最先进的AI检测模型(Glickenhaus等,2026年)来对自然性进行通用测量. 作为补充,我们还报告针对数据集的绩效,对歧视者进行了有关我们目标体的培训(Li等,2017年)。

blocks.en: GAN-Style Training for Language Models: Past work has explored GAN-style adversarial training ( Goodfellow et al., 2014a ) within language modeling ( Fedus et al., 2018 ; de Masson d’Autume et al., 2019 ) . Most relevant work uses adversarial training for response generation in dialogues or for assistant dialogue agents ( Li et al., 2017 ; Liu and Lane, 2018 ) , where Li et al. (2017) also conduct evaluation with trained discriminators. Since the inception of LLMs, however, this GAN-style training has largely been abandoned. While trained discriminators exist for AI detection ( Thai et al., 2026 ; Glickenhaus et al., 2026 ) , they are not used for model training. When the notion of discriminability is introduced to training, it is through prompted LLM judges ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , which we show harms naturalness. Our work uses GAN-style adversarial training for user simulation instead.
blocks.zh: GAN-语言模型的系统培训: 过去的工作探索了GAN风格的对抗训练(Goodfellow等,2014年a)在语言建模(Fedus等,2018年;de Masson d ' Autume等,2019年). 大部分相关工作采用对抗性培训,用于对话中产生反应或助理对话代理(Li等,2017;Liu和Lane,2018),而Li等(2017)也与经过培训的受歧视者进行评价. 然而,自LLMS创立以来,这种GAN式的培训基本被放弃了. 虽有经过培训的歧视性人员接受人工智能检测(泰国等,2026;Glickenhaus等,2026),但他们并不用于模式培训。 在将歧视概念引入培训时,这是通过促使LLM法官(Wang等人,2026年),我们显示了对自然的伤害。 我们的工作是使用GAN式的对抗训练来进行用户模拟.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduce UserLM-2.0, a user simulator for User-AI interaction trained via RL to optimize both task-fidelity and naturalness. We operationalize naturalness as fooling a lightweight discriminator that is periodically retrained throughout RL on real and model-generated conversations. We compare our model against existing trained user simulators and state-of-the-art assistant models prompted to act as users, and find that UserLM-2.0 produces valid conversations meeting both task-fidelity and naturalness criteria 46.2% of the time, more than three times the rate of the next-best user simulator. This gap widens as task-complexity increases, with 12.6% of UserLM-2.0 conversations being valid at the highest task complexity, while the next-best model is valid only 0.8% of the time.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了UserLM-2.0,这是一个用户模拟器,用于通过RL培训的User-AI交互,以优化任务真实性和自然性. 我们利用自然来欺骗一个轻量级歧视者, 在整个RL中定期对它进行真正的和模式性的对话。 我们比较了我们的模型与现有的训练有素的用户模拟器和被催生为用户的最先进的助理模型,发现UserLM-2.0产生符合任务真实性和自然性标准的有效对话时间为46.2%,是次佳用户模拟器的三倍以上. 这一差距随着任务复杂度的增加而扩大,12.6%的UserLM-2.0对话在任务最复杂时有效,而次好模式在时间上只有0.8%有效.

blocks.en: Appendix A Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据集构建

blocks.en: A.1 Dataset Filtering
blocks.zh: A.1 数据集过滤

blocks.en: We build on top of the filtering strategy of Naous et al. (2026) for WildChat-1M ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) to filter conversations in WildChat-4.8M. We restrict our attention to the already filtered non-toxic component of the overall WildChat-4.8M dataset. We firstly filter out conversations that were marked as non-English by WildChat. We then filter out conversations featuring heavily templated language. Specifically, we filter out any conversation whose opening 7-gram occurs at least 50 times in the dataset and whose opening 12-gram similarly occurs at least 15 times. We also filter out conversations whose opening turn is repeated verbatim as the first turn at least 50 times in the dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们利用Naous等人(2026年)的过滤策略,将WildChat-1M(赵等,2024年)过滤到WildChat-4.8M的对话. 我们只关注整个WildChat-4.8M数据集中已经过滤过的无毒成分. 我们首先过滤那些被WildChat标记为非英语的对话. 然后我们过滤出以高模板语言为主的对话。 具体地说,我们过滤出任何在数据集中开口7克至少发生50次,开口12克同样发生至少15次的对话. 我们还过滤了在数据集中至少50次以逐字方式重复的开口对话。

blocks.en: Going beyond Naous et al. (2026) , we separately observe many interactions attempting to circumvent the restrictions of the WildChat API by placing interaction histories or few-shot prompts inside the first user turn in an unconventional manner. We heuristically remove such interactions by checking for “User:”, “Assistant:”, “System:” and “Bot:” strings in the first turn. As our goal is to model multi-turn interactions, we also filter out conversations that feature only one user turn. Finally, we filter out conversations containing toxic strings, including any conversation featuring mention of the Doki Doki Literature Club characters Natsuki, Sayori, Monika and Yuri to remove interactions from one particular, prolific user generating.
blocks.zh: 超越 Naous等人(2026年),我们分别观察到许多互动试图绕过WildChat API的限制,将互动历史或几发的提示放入第一个用户以非常规方式转动. 我们通过检查“用户”、“助理”、“系统:”和“批量:”的顺序,迅速消除这种相互作用。 由于我们的目标是建立多回合互动模式,我们也过滤出只包含一个用户回合的对话。 最后,我们过滤了包含有毒弦的对话,包括任何提及多克多克文学俱乐部人物夏树、萨约里、莫妮卡和尤里的对话,以去除某个特定的、繁多的用户产生的相互作用。

blocks.en: A.2 Dataset Splits
blocks.zh: A.2 数据集分割

blocks.en: In order to construct the train/val/test split, we similarly follow Naous et al. (2026) . We use WildChat metadata to group users by country and split the users of each country into train, validation and test splits with a 90/5/5 ratio. Each split then contains interactions associated with users from the respective split. For training and validation sets, we allocate 167625 and 6816 intents for SFT; 10,000 and 1,000 intents for RL; and 3,200 and 1,000 for intents Discriminator training. The 2,000 datapoint test set used for evaluation is then subsampled from the remaining 9,608 remaining test set conversations. It is constructed to feature intents containing 1 to 7 sub-goals, with balance in the number of intents per sub-goals count. In practice, the test dataset contains a small number of intents with 1 and 7 sub-goals. As a result, the test set features 202 intents featuring 1 sub-goals, 336 intents featuring 2-5 sub-goals each, 335 intents featuring 6 sub-goals and 119 intents featuring 7 sub-goals.
blocks.zh: 为了建造列车/val/测试分机,我们同样跟随Naous等人(2026年)。 我们使用WildChat元数据按国家划分的用户群,将每个国家的用户分成列车,验证和测试分拆,比例为90/5/5. 然后每个拆分包含与相应拆分的用户相关的交互. 关于培训和鉴定成套项目,我们为SFT分配了167625和6816份意向;为RL分配了10 000和1 000份意向;为歧视者意图培训分配了3 200和1 000份意向。 用于评价的2000个数据点测试集随后被从剩余的9,608个测试集对话中被分样. 它旨在突出包含1至7个次级目标的意图,每个次级目标的意图数目要平衡。 在实践中,测试数据集包含少量包含1个和7个分目标的意向. 因此,测试的特征是202个意图,其中1个次级目标,336个意图,每个次级目标2-5个,335个意图,其中6个次级目标,119个意图,其中7个次级目标。

blocks.zh: A.3 有意开采

blocks.en: We construct the generic user intent c c and its fully-specified counterpart c ∗ c^{*} separately. We extract generic intents c c for all 199,249 conversations with Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , using the extraction prompt of Naous et al. (2026) with modifications (Figure 3 ). In practice, we only insert user turns into the prompt to avoid assistant outputs from incorrectly influencing the extracted intent. We use the recommended temperature of 0.7, top-p of 0.8, top-k of 20 and generate at most 512 tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们分别构建通用用户意图 c 及其完全指定的对应方 c 。 我们利用Naous等人的提取提示,为与Qune3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507(Yang等,2025年)的所有199,249次谈话提取了通用意图c. (2026) 有修改(图3.). 在实践中,我们只插入用户转换为提示,以避免助理产出不正确地影响提取的意图。 我们使用0.7的推荐温度,上-p为0.8,上-k为20,最多产生512个令牌.

blocks.en: We then extract fully-specified intents c ∗ c^{*} for the RL dataset interactions and the full test set. We used the best-available GPT model in both cases. For RL data extraction, this was GPT-5.3, while for the test set extraction this was GPT-5.6-Terra. We performed inference with a temperature of 1, without any reasoning enabled for both models. We first few-shot prompt the model to extract sub-goals given the user turns of the conversation (Figure 4 ). This often results in sub-goals that are highly specific and unlikely to be inferred from the generic intent c c . As a result, we prompt the model to perform a further genericization step on the extracted sub-goals while conditioning on c c (Figure 5 ), which finally yields c ∗ c^{*} .
blocks.zh: 然后,我们为 RL 数据集的相互作用和完整的测试集提取充分指定的意图 c * 。 在这两种情况下,我们都采用了最佳的GPT模式。 对于RL数据提取,这是GPT-5.3,而测试集的提取则是GPT-5.6-Terra。 我们的推论温度为1, 没有为两种模型提出任何推理。 鉴于对话的用户转折情况(图4),我们首先用几发子弹敦促模型提取分目标。 这往往导致次级目标非常具体,不可能从一般意图cc推断。 因此,我们促使该模型在c(图5)的基础上,对所提取的次级目标采取进一步通用化步骤,最终得出c 。

blocks.en: Appendix B Training Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 培训详情

blocks.en: B.1 SFT Training Details
blocks.zh: B.1 资助恐怖主义 培训详情

blocks.en: We use Llama3.1-8B-Instruct as the backbone for UserLM-2.0. Before performing any training, we add a dedicated token for the <|endconversation|> tag and initialize its token embedding and language model head embedding as the mean embedding value. We also update the model’s chat template to add a user role header rather than the default assistant role header before generation.
blocks.zh: 我们用Llama3.1-8B-Instruct作为UserLM-2.0的骨干. 在进行任何训练之前,我们为 \\ endconversation\ 标记添加一个专用的符号,并初始化其符号嵌入和语言模型头嵌入作为平均嵌入值. 我们还更新了模型的聊天模板,以便在生成前添加一个用户角色头,而不是默认的助理角色头.

blocks.en: For SFT training, we construct the dataset such that each datapoint is one single user turn, conditioned on the prior, templated conversation as context. We perform one epoch of SFT training, using a batch size of 1024 samples, learning rate of 2e-5, a weight decay of 1e-4 and AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) as the optimizer. We select the checkpoint with the best validation loss, measured every 100 steps, for subsequent RL. We use TRL’s SFTTrainer for training ( von Werra et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 就SFT培训而言,我们构建数据集时,每个数据点都是单一的用户回合,以先前的模板对话为上下文条件。 我们进行一个时代的SFT训练,使用分批1024个样本,学习率为2e-5,体重衰减为1e-4和AdamW(Lohchilov and Hutter, 2019)作为优化者. 我们选择检查点的验证损失最好,每100个步骤测量一次,用于随后的RL. 使用TRL的SFTtrainer进行训练(von Werra等,2020年).

blocks.en: B.2 RL Training Details
blocks.zh: B.2 RL 培训细节

blocks.en: Figure 6: Prompt template for the quality judge, with examples removed due to space. Each few-shot example and {conversation} are replaced by the user turns, preceded by the system prompts.
blocks.zh: 图6:高质量法官的快速模板,因空间原因删除实例。 每一个相片相片的例和{ conversation}被用户转动所取代,在系统提示之前.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Prompt template for the coverage judge, with full few-shot examples removed due to space. Each {example_i} block and the {conversation} block are replaced by the associated conversation featuring only the user turns, with conditioning on the full task intent.
blocks.zh: 图7:覆盖法官的即时模板,由于空间原因删除了完全少见的例子。 每个 {例_i} 块和 { conversation} 块被仅由用户转动的关联对话所取代, 并附带关于全部任务意图的附加条件 。

blocks.en: We perform RL training on top of the UserLM-2.0-SFT model, using the GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) implementation of the verl library ( Sheng et al., 2024 ) . We use a batch size of 64 with a GRPO group size of 8, with only one on-policy update step per rollout. We set the GRPO ϵ = 0.2 \epsilon=0.2 and KL loss weight to β = 0.001 \beta=0.001 . We use the AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) optimizer with a constant learning rate of 1e-6, beta values of (0.9, 0.999), weight decay of 0.01 0.01 and a gradient clipping norm of 1.0 1.0 . We perform one epoch of training for a total of 156 steps and validate model performance every 25 steps.
blocks.zh: 我们在UserLM-2.0-SFT模式上进行RL训练,采用GRPO(Shao等,2024年)执行活字库(Sheng等,2024年). 我们使用64个批量规模,GRPO小组规模为8个,每推出一个政策更新步骤。 GRPO = 0.2\epsilon = 0.2,KL减重为 β = 0.001\beta = 0.01。 我们使用亚当W(Lohchilov和Hutter,2019年)优化器,恒定学习率为1e-6,β值为(0.9,0.999),重量衰减为0.01,梯度剪接规范为1.01.0. 我们共进行了156个培训阶段,每25个阶段验证一次示范业绩。

blocks.en: We simulate conversations with a maximum of N = 6 N=6 user turns and N = 5 N=5 assistant turns. If the user does not terminate the conversation at the sixth user turn, we consider the conversation not terminated. We use Qwen3.5-9B ( Team, 2026 ) without thinking as the assistant model, with a system prompt of “You are a helpful AI assistant. Answer the user’s questions accurately and helpfully.” At each user turn, we do standard temperature sampling with a temperature of 1.0 1.0 for at most 1024 tokens per turn. At each assistant turn, we do sampling with a temperature of 0.7, top-p of 0.8 and top-k of 20 for a maximum of 2048 tokens. During validation, we sample four rollouts per input intent.
blocks.zh: 我们模拟对话时最多为N = 6 N = 6 用户回合和N = 5 N = 5 助手回合. 如果用户在第六次用户回合时没有终止对话,我们认为对话没有终止. 我们使用Qune3.5-9B(Team, 2026)而不考虑作为助理模型,系统提示为“你是一个有帮助的AI助手。 准确而有益地回答用户的问题。 在每个用户转弯时,我们进行标准温度取样,温度为1.01.0,每转弯最多1024个令牌。 每个助手转弯时,我们进行取样,温度为0.7,上p为0.8,上k为20,最高为2048个令牌. 在验证过程中,我们抽取了每个输入意向的四次推出.

blocks.en: We also use Qwen3.5-9B as the judge model due to its quality at its parameter size. The prompt for Coverage is shown in Figure 7 . It ingests the fully-specified intent c ∗ c^{*} and the simulated conversation, filtered to contain only the user turns. We perform greedy sampling without thinking for a maximum of 32 tokens. The Quality prompt is likewise shown in Figure 6 . It ingest the generic intent c c and the simulated conversation with only user turns shown. We perform greedy sampling with 16 tokens for it. However, we check verbatim repetition of the input prompt and prior turns in a rule-based manner before invoking the judge for Quality. We set the termination reward λ = 0.2 \lambda=0.2 . Finally, we retrain the discriminator every 25 25 steps, after validation.
blocks.zh: 我们还使用Qwen3.5-9B作为裁判模型,因其参数大小的质量. 覆盖的提示如图7所示。 它吸收了完全指定的意向c * 和模拟的对话,过滤后只包含用户转动. 我们进行贪婪的采样 却不考虑最多32个信使 图6也显示了质量提示。 它吸收了通用意图c和只显示用户转动的模拟对话. 我们进行贪婪的采样 16个标志。 然而,我们在援引法官的质量要求之前,先按规则逐字逐句地检查迅速重复输入的情况。 我们设定解雇奖励 = 0.2\lambda=0.2。 最后,我们每25个步骤重新训练歧视者,经过验证。

blocks.en: In order to construct the few-shot examples for the quality prompt, we sampled a set of conversations from an SFT-initialized model and then manually labeled each individual example according to what error mode it represents or whether there is no error mode. We then constructed a dataset of 15 examples for each error mode, and for the valid category. We randomly constructed 10 few-shot prompts from this set of examples and evaluated model performance on the remainder. We picked the best performing set, which had an accuracy of 85% with no errors for valid conversations. For coverage, we likewise sampled a set of 100 conversations and annotated the coverage score of each conversation, using GPT-5.3 with reasoning. We then constructed 10 three-shot prompts and evaluated each against the remainder of the 100 conversation pool. We then picked the best-performing selection in terms of MAE against the number of sub-goals in a conversation, at 0.773. We perform evaluation with GPT-5.6-Luna to improve the robustness and reliability of the LLM judge.
blocks.zh: 为了构建质量快取的几发实例,我们从一个SFT-初始化的模型中抽取了一组对话,然后按照它所代表的出错模式或是否没有出错模式,手动给每个单个实例贴上标签. 然后我们为每个错误模式和有效类别构建了15个实例的数据集。 我们从这组例子中随机构建出10个几发提示,并评价了其余的模型性能. 我们选了最优秀的一组 精度高达85% 有效对话没有出错 对于报道,我们同样抽取了一组100个对话,并用GPT-5.3来说明每次对话的覆盖面。 然后,我们建造了10个三发提示,并按100个对话池的其余部分对每个提示进行评估。 然后,我们从一次谈话中以0.773的分目标数量来选择在MAE方面表现最好的选择。 我们与GPT-5.6-Luna一起进行评估,以提高LLM法官的稳健性和可靠性.

blocks.en: For checkpoint selection, we select the checkpoint leading to the most natural interactions above a set coverage threshold. Firstly, we find that the Human Reference coverage score on the validation set, as computed by Qwen3.5-9B, is 85.6%. Given this, we set a validation coverage score of 85% as the lower threshold for valid checkpoints. We use the similarity between utterance-length and turn-count histogram distributions of generated conversations and Human Reference conversations as a cheap proxy for naturalness. We use the Jensen-Shannon Divergence as the distance metric and choose the checkpoint receiving the lowest JSD above the 85% coverage threshold. For the No Coverage experiment, there were no such checkpoints. As a result, we chose the checkpoint with the lowest JSD among the two checkpoints that had the highest coverage score.
blocks.zh: 为了选择检查站,我们选择的检查站导致最自然的互动超过设定的覆盖门槛。 首先,我们发现,根据Quen3.5-9B的计算, " 人类参考 " 的鉴定分数为85.6%。 有鉴于此,我们将85%的验证覆盖率定为有效检查站的下限。 我们利用所生成的对话和人类参考对话的表达长度和转计直径分布之间的相似性,作为自然的廉价代名词。 我们用Jensen-Shannon Difference作为距离度量, 选择接受85%覆盖阈值最低的JSD的检查站。 在无覆盖试验中,没有这样的检查站。 因此,我们选择了在覆盖率最高的两个检查站中拥有最低JSD的检查站。

blocks.en: B.3 Discriminator Training Details
blocks.zh: B.3 歧视者培训详情

blocks.en: We use the 395M ModernBERT-Large ( Warner et al., 2025 ) as the discriminator. For each task intent, we sample one simulated conversation (using the user and assistant models) and one real conversation (from the ground truth dataset). We use only the user turns for discrimination, as we found including assistant turns made simulated conversations perfectly discriminable due to stylistic differences between assistants. This ensures that our dataset is always balanced.
blocks.zh: 我们使用395M ModernBERT-Large(Warner等,2025年)作为歧视者. 对于每项任务意图,我们抽取一个模拟对话(使用用户和助理模型)和一个真实对话(从地面真理数据集). 我们只使用用户转而歧视,因为我们发现包括助理转而制作的模拟对话,由于助理之间的形式差异,完全可以歧视。 这确保了我们的数据集总是平衡的。

blocks.en: For the initial discriminator, we sample interactions on the dedicated Discriminator training and validation set with UserLM-2.0-SFT, using the same inference procedure as in RL training. For discriminator re-training during RL, on the other hand, half of our training dataset consists of conversations based on task intents from the most recent 25 25 RL steps. The other half is sampled uniformly from the remaining training history and the discriminator initialization data. We train for five epochs and pick the checkpoint achieving the best validation accuracy. We use AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) as the optimizer. We use a learning rate of 2e-5 with linear decay and a warm-up ratio of 0.05, a weight decay of 1e-4 and gradient clipping norm of 1.0. The batch-size is 64.
blocks.zh: 对于初始歧视者,我们用与RL培训相同的推论程序,对与UserLM-2.0-SFT的专用歧视者培训和验证集的互动进行抽样。 另一方面,对于歧视者在RL期间的再培训,我们的培训数据集有一半是根据最近25个RL步骤的任务意图进行的对话。 另一半统一取自其余培训历史和歧视者初始化数据。 我们为五个时代训练 并选择检查点 达到最好的验证准确性。 我们使用亚当W(Lohchilov and Hutter, 2019)作为优化者. 我们采用2e-5的学习速率,线性衰变和热速比为0.05,重量衰减为1e-4,梯度剪接规范为1.0. 批量大小为64.

blocks.en: C.4 Naturalness Metrics
blocks.zh: C.4 自然计量

blocks.en: We use the same training hyperparameters and backbone to train discriminators for Naturalness-Specific and Naturalness-General. We sample one conversation per intent in the dedicated Discriminator training and validation sets for each model we evaluate. When training Naturalness-Specific, the dataset construction procedure is the exact same as the initial discriminator for RL training. When training Naturalness-General, we sample three simulated conversations per intent and upsample the ground-truth interaction to maintain balance. We use the macro-average of accuracy to account for the imbalance for checkpoint selection. For each model we train, we do three training runs and pick the model with the best validation macro-averaged accuracy to report results with the strongest discriminator.
blocks.zh: 我们使用同样的训练超参数和主干器,为自然和自然一般培训歧视者。 我们在针对我们评价的每个模式的 专门歧视者培训和鉴定集中 抽取了一次谈话 在培训自然-特定时,数据集构建程序与RL培训初始歧视者完全相同. 在训练"自然通"时,我们抽取了每个意图的三个模拟对话,并取出地面-真实互动来保持平衡. 我们利用精确度的宏观平均值来计算检查站选择的不平衡。 对于我们所训练的每个模型,我们进行三次训练,并用最优的验证宏观平均精度来选择模型,以最强的歧义者来报告结果.

blocks.en: C.5 Behavioral Metric Definitions
blocks.zh: C.5 行为计量定义

blocks.en: Our behavioral analysis uses turn-level annotations of which subgoals in the fully specified intent c ∗ c^{*} are expressed on each user turn. Each goal is counted at most once per turn and assistant turns are excluded. We define the two repetition and verbosity metrics reported in Table 3 below:
blocks.zh: 我们的行为分析使用回合级说明,每个用户回合都表示完全指定的意向中的子目标 c * 。 每个入球最多每个转弯一次,助理转弯不计算在内. 我们界定了下文表3所汇报的两个重复和动词度量:

blocks.en: 1. Revisitation: The percentage of goal mentions where the mentioned goal has already appeared in an earlier user turn. Each distinct goal in each turn constitutes one goal mention. 2. Repetition-only: The percentage of all user turns that exclusively features goals that were already covered in prior turns. 3. Empty: The percentage of all user turns that cover no task subgoal. 4. Words/goal: Total words across all user turns divided by the number of distinct subgoals expressed in the conversation, reported as the median over eligible conversations. We define words as Unicode alphanumeric sequences, retaining internal apostrophes, following Unicode compatibility normalization and lowercasing.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 复访: 目标的百分比提到在较早的用户回合中已经出现上述目标的地方。 每个不同的目标都包含一个目标。 2. 仅重复: 全部用户转弯的百分比仅涉及以前转弯时已经涵盖的目标。 3. 空: 所有用户转弯的百分比不包括任务次级目标。 4. 词语/目标:所有用户的词语总数取而代之的是对话中表示的不同次级目标的数目,报告为合格对话的中位数。 我们把单词定义为Unicode字母数序列,在Unicode兼容性正常化后保留了内部的apostrophes并下同.

blocks.en: With the exception of Words/goal, we average scores within each intent and then equally across intents, separately for each model. Words/goal instead pools eligible conversation-level ratios across intents before taking the median.

blocks.en: We plot Figure 2 using task intents where the Human Reference spent at most 6 turns. When computing the bar for a given turn, we pool all partial conversations leading up to that turn and compute averages across conversations. The cumulative coverage is the average coverage achieved by the partial conversation at that turn. We compute the proportion of new subgoals by determining the number of newly mentioned subgoals at the given turn, dividing over the total subgoal count and averaging across conversations. We similarly compute the proportion of subgoal revisitation by determining the number of revisited subgoals, dividing over the total subgoal count and averaging.
blocks.zh: 我们用任务意图绘制图2 人类参考文献最多花费了6个回合 在计算一个特定回合时,我们汇集了导致这一回合的所有部分对话,并计算了各种对话的平均值。 累计覆盖是当时部分对话达到的平均覆盖. 我们计算新的次级目标的比例,方法是确定在某一回合中新提到的次级目标的数目,除以次级目标总数并按对话的平均数计算。 同样,我们通过确定重新审视的次级目标的数目,除去次级目标总数和平均数,计算重新审视次级目标的比例。

blocks.en: We analyze the performance of each trained discriminator on each validation step. We run inference on each validation step’s simulated rollouts using the trained discriminators. Figure 16 contains results for UserLM-2.0. The rows represent validation steps, while columns represent the discriminator used to evaluate them. Each index then contains the average P disc ​ ( y = real ∣ u 1 ^ ​ … ​ u k ^ , c ) P_{\text{disc}}(y=\text{real}\mid\hat{u_{1}}...\hat{u_{k}},c) for the corresponding validation step rollouts using the corresponding discriminator.
blocks.zh: 我们分析每个训练有素的歧视者在每个验证步骤上的表现。 我们用训练有素的歧视者来推论每个验证步骤的模拟推出。 图16载有用户LM-2.0的结果。 行代表验证步骤,而列代表用来评价它们的歧视者. 每一个索引然后包含平均 P 盘 (y = real ∣u 1 ^. u k ^, c) P_{\text{disc}} (y=\text{ real}\mid\ hat{u_{1}}... \hat{u_{k}}}},c),用于使用相应的歧视符进行相应的验证步骤推出.

blocks.en: For UserLM-2.0, the matrices have a triangular structure. The lower triangular component, featuring validation steps evaluated by earlier discriminators, each predominantly have high P disc ​ ( y = real ) P_{\text{disc}}(y=\text{real}) values for simulated rollouts. This indicates that as models learn to fool a newly retrained discriminator, they also keep on fooling earlier discriminators. Simultaneously, the upper triangular component predominantly features low P disc ​ ( y = real ) P_{\text{disc}}(y=\text{real}) values. This is intuitive, as each retrained discriminator is trained on both the most recent 25 steps and simulated conversations from earlier in training. This enables retrained discriminators to remain robust to and discourage reward hacking behavior from early steps as well.
blocks.zh: 对于UserLM-2.0,矩阵具有三角结构. 由早期歧视者评估的验证步骤组成的下三角部分,每个部分主要有高P盘 (y = real) P_{\text{disc}} (y=\text{ real}) 值来模拟展开. 这表明,当模特们学会欺骗新再训练的歧视行为人时,他们也不断欺骗早先的歧视行为人。 同时,上三角元件主要具有低P盘 (y = real ) P_{\text{disc}}(y=\text{real})等值. 这是直觉性的,因为每个再训练的歧视行为人都接受了最近25个步骤的培训,并且从早期的训练中模拟了对话。 这使得重新培训的歧视行为人能够保持强力,并阻止早期的黑客行为。

blocks.en: To better understand how dynamic discriminators then affect alignment with the human reference distribution, we look at output-length and conversation turn-counts as proxies. Specifically, we construct histograms of output-length and turn-counts for all models, using their validation rollouts during training, and compare them against histograms for corresponding human interactions using Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD). Figure 15 (c) plots the averaged JSD value over training. Both the UserLM-2.0 and No Coverage runs sustain a low JSD throughout training and can correct themselves when JSD spikes. The alternative reward variants and the No Naturalness ablation, on the other hand, each increasingly diverges. This divergence is driven primarily by an increase in output-length, with the LLM judge variants ultimately reaching up to 400 words per turn on average.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地了解动态歧视者如何影响与人类参考分布的一致,我们将产出长度和对话转换计为代词。 具体地说,我们利用所有模型在训练期间的验证推开来构建输出长的直方图和转数,并用Jensen-Shannon Divergence(JSD)与直方图进行比较,以便进行相应的人类互动。 图15(c)列出了平均联合后勤开发值高于培训值。 UserLM-2.0和No Speed运行在整个培训期间维持了低水平的JSD,并在JSD猛增时能够自我纠正. 另一方面,其他奖励变体和 " 无自然效应 " 则越来越不同。 造成这种差异的主要原因是产出长度增加,LLM法官的变体最终达到平均每个回合400个字。
